title: a problem's own `and` function was read as conjunction

reproducer.claim: the problem is unsatisfiable (the certificate refutes it)

twin.claim: unsatisfiable, with a correct refutation, and it contains the reproducer's construct: the problem declares its own `and`, as the reproducer does, and asserts one application of it and its negation; the refutation is resolution on those two premises

witness.input: the reproducer's problem script, with (get-model) after every check-sat
witness.observed: sat at every check, with a model under which an independent evaluator (smt_model_check in the runner) finds every assertion and assumption in scope true

no_control: Clean main refuses any problem that declares `and` ('and' is a built-in operator and cannot be declared or defined), so no certificate over this construct is accepted, the twin included; clean-external is the only verifier of an SMT entry
